orientation.description: Bar direction; vertical renders columns, horizontal renders bars

show_average_line.description: When true, renders the dashed average reference line across the plot

show_value_labels.description: When true, prints each bar's value as a label outside its value end

average_line_label.description: Label drawn at the average reference line; defaults to 'Average'

row_limit.description: How many bars to draw from the ranked set; absence means the component default

rank_window.description: Which end of the ranking the row limit keeps

value_decimals.description: Fixed decimal places for value labels; absence derives them from the data's magnitude

custom_title.description: Custom chart title; null means use the column's label

custom_subtitle.description: Custom chart subtitle; null means no subtitle

custom_x_axis_title.description: Custom title for the category (subject) axis; null means no title

custom_y_axis_title.description: Custom title for the value (metric) axis; null means use the column's label

font_family.description: Font family for chart text; null means Highcharts default
